pub struct EngineConfig { #[uniffi(default = 4096)] pub context_size: u64, pub backend: BackendPreference, #[uniffi(default = None)] pub bundle_repo: Option<Arc<BundleRepo>>, #[uniffi(default = None)] pub draft_model: Option<String>, #[uniffi(default = false)] pub gpu_depthformer: bool, }

pub struct ModelMetadata { pub architecture: String, pub max_seq_len: u32, pub vocab_size: u32, pub has_chat_template: bool, pub quantization: String, pub add_bos_token: bool, pub add_eos_token: bool, pub cpu_backend: String, }
pub struct ModalityCapabilities { pub text_in: bool, pub text_out: bool, pub image_in: bool, pub audio_in: bool, pub audio_out: bool, }
pub struct ChatMessage { pub role: String, pub content: String, }
pub struct ToolDef { pub name: String, pub description: Option<String>, pub parameters_json: String, }
pub struct ToolCall { pub name: String, pub arguments_json: String, }
pub struct LeapBundleEntry { pub name: String, pub quants: Vec<String>, }
pub enum KvCompression { #[default] None, F16, TurboQuant { seed: u64, keys: bool, values: bool }, }

pub struct SessionConfig { #[uniffi(default = None)] pub max_seq_len: Option<u32>, #[uniffi(default = None)] pub kv_compression: Option<KvCompression>, #[uniffi(default = 0)] pub n_keep: u32, #[uniffi(default = None)] pub seed: Option<u64>, #[uniffi(default = 512)] pub ubatch_size: u32, #[uniffi(default = false)] pub gpu_depthformer: bool, }
pub struct SpecDecodeConfig { #[uniffi(default = 2)] pub ngram: u32, #[uniffi(default = 6)] pub k: u32, }

pub struct GenerateOpts { #[uniffi(default = 256)] pub max_tokens: u32, #[uniffi(default = None)] pub seed: Option<u64>, #[uniffi(default = 0.7)] pub temperature: f32, #[uniffi(default = 0.9)] pub top_p: f32, #[uniffi(default = 40)] pub top_k: u32, #[uniffi(default = 0.05)] pub min_p: f32, #[uniffi(default = 1.1)] pub repetition_penalty: f32, #[uniffi(default = [])] pub stop_tokens: Vec<u32>, #[uniffi(default = false)] pub ignore_eos: bool, #[uniffi(default = None)] pub grammar: Option<String>, #[uniffi(default = [])] pub grammar_trigger_tokens: Vec<u32>, #[uniffi(default = 16)] pub flush_every_tokens: u32, #[uniffi(default = 50)] pub flush_every_ms: u32, #[uniffi(default = None)] pub spec: Option<SpecDecodeConfig>, }
pub enum FinishReason { MaxTokens, Stop, Cancelled, ContextFull, GrammarDeadEnd, Error { message: String, }, }

pub struct GenerateSummary { pub tokens_generated: u32, pub prompt_eval_tokens: u32, pub prompt_eval_ms: u32, pub decode_ms: u32, pub total_duration_ms: u32, pub decode_tok_per_sec: f64, pub prompt_eval_tok_per_sec: f64, pub finish_reason: FinishReason, }
pub struct GenerateOutput { pub text: String, pub tokens: Vec<u32>, pub summary: GenerateSummary, }
pub struct AudioInput { pub pcm: Vec<f32>, #[uniffi(default = 16000)] pub sample_rate: u32, }
pub struct UserMessage { #[uniffi(default = None)] pub text: Option<String>, #[uniffi(default = [])] pub images: Vec<Vec<u8>>, #[uniffi(default = None)] pub audio: Option<AudioInput>, }
pub enum FfiVadSampleRate { Rate16kHz, Rate8kHz, }
pub struct FfiSpeechTimestamp { pub start_sample: u64, pub end_sample: u64, pub start_ms: f32, pub end_ms: f32, }

pub struct FfiVadConfig { #[uniffi(default = 0.5)] pub threshold: f32, #[uniffi(default = 0.35)] pub neg_threshold: f32, #[uniffi(default = 64)] pub min_speech_duration_ms: u32, #[uniffi(default = 100)] pub min_silence_duration_ms: u32, #[uniffi(default = 30)] pub speech_pad_ms: u32, #[uniffi(default = None)] pub frame_stride: Option<u32>, }
pub enum FfiVadEvent { SpeechStart { sample: u64, ms: f32, }, SpeechEnd { start_sample: u64, end_sample: u64, start_ms: f32, end_ms: f32, }, }
pub struct FfiHotwordConfig { pub threshold: f32, pub cooldown_ms: u32, pub step_ms: u32, pub window_ms: u32, pub pre_roll_ms: u32, pub vad_threshold: f32, }
pub struct FfiHotwordScore { pub keyword: String, pub score: f32, }
pub struct FfiHotwordEvent { pub keyword: String, pub sample_offset: u64, pub command_start_sample: u64, pub timestamp_ms: f32, pub confidence: f32, }
pub struct FfiWhisperTranscribeOpts { pub language: Option<String>, pub translate: bool, pub timestamps: bool, pub max_tokens: Option<u32>, pub temperature: Option<f32>, }
pub struct FfiEntitySpan { pub entity_type: String, pub start_char: u64, pub end_char: u64, pub start_token: u64, pub end_token: u64, pub text: String, pub score: f32, }

pub enum FfiError { #[error("modality not supported by this model")] UnsupportedModality, #[error("inference_type `{inference_type}` is not supported in this version of cera")] UnsupportedInferenceType { inference_type: String }, #[error("session is busy with another operation")] Busy, #[error("cancelled")] Cancelled, #[error("context window ({max_seq_len}) exceeded by {by} tokens")] ContextOverflow { max_seq_len: u32, by: u32 }, #[error("empty input")] EmptyInput, #[error("io: {detail}")] Io { detail: String }, #[error("backend: {detail}")] Backend { detail: String }, #[error("grammar: {detail}")] GrammarParse { detail: String }, #[error("token id {id} out of range (vocab_size {vocab_size})")] InvalidToken { id: u32, vocab_size: u32 }, #[error("lora: {detail}")] LoraParse { detail: String }, #[error("out of memory: could not allocate {requested_bytes} bytes")] OutOfMemory { requested_bytes: u64 }, #[error( "model already configured for KV compression mode `{configured}`; \
         cannot reconfigure to `{requested}` — create a separate model instance" )] KvCompressionConflict { configured: String, requested: String, }, #[error("LoRA adapter not supported by this backend: {detail}")] LoraUnsupportedByBackend { detail: String }, #[error("chat validation: {error}")] ChatValidation { error: ValidationError }, }
pub enum ToolFormat { Lfm2Pythonic, Hermes, }
